title: Dissecting model behavior through agent trajectories
title_zh: 通过 Agent 轨迹剖析模型行为
abstract_en: AI agent performance is not just a modeling problem, it is fundamentally a systems problem. The advanced capabilities of models are realized through agent harnesses. Therefore, a gap between model assumptions and harness behavior can easily prevent the model's full capabilities from translating into agent performance. We formalize this as the `intent-execution' gap: the mismatch between what the model intends and what the harness executes, and vice versa. We argue that minimizing this intent-execution gap is as important as other aspects of harness design such as tools and execution loops. To illustrate the impact of this harness-model alignment, we develop a simple and customizable harness called `Simple Strands Agent' (SSA). SSA aims to find the bulk of common patterns which generalize across different model families (such as Claude, Gemini, GPT, Grok, Qwen), as well as a small number of model-specific preferences. We make two contributions: (i) we $\textbf{reproduce or improve on the pass@1}$ performance reported by diverse model-provider families on popular agentic benchmarks (SWE-Pro, SWE-Verified and Terminal-Bench-2), and (ii) building on an $\textbf{analysis of 138k trajectories generated by SSA}$, we look beyond the $\texttt{pass@1}$ numbers which tend to be relatively even across frontier models. By representing agent trajectories in code state-spaces, we observe model-level differences in problem-solving behavior. Finer-grained metrics such as edit frequency, testing activity, and phase-transitions reveal how individual models allocate effort across different stages of autonomous problem solving.
abstract_zh: 本文指出，AI agent 性能不仅是建模问题，更是系统问题：模型能力需要通过 agent harness 才能落地。作者将模型意图与 harness 实际执行之间的不匹配形式化为“intent-execution gap”，并认为缩小这一差距与工具设计、执行循环等 harness 设计同等重要。为研究 harness-model alignment，论文提出一个简单且可定制的 harness：Simple Strands Agent（SSA），用于总结 Claude、Gemini、GPT、Grok、Qwen 等不同模型家族间的通用模式与少量模型特定偏好。实验上，SSA 在 SWE-Pro、SWE-Verified、Terminal-Bench-2 等 agentic benchmarks 上复现或提升了多个模型厂商报告的 pass@1 性能。进一步地，基于 SSA 生成的 13.8 万条 agent trajectories，作者超越 pass@1 指标，将轨迹表示到代码状态空间中，分析不同模型的问题解决行为差异。编辑频率、测试活动、阶段转换等细粒度指标揭示了各模型在自主解题不同阶段的努力分配方式。
key_points_zh: 提出“intent-execution gap”概念，强调模型意图与 agent harness 执行行为之间的错配会显著影响最终 agent 性能。
构建 Simple Strands Agent（SSA），一个简单、可定制的 harness，用于适配 Claude、Gemini、GPT、Grok、Qwen 等不同模型家族。
在 SWE-Pro、SWE-Verified 和 Terminal-Bench-2 上，SSA 复现或提升了多类前沿模型报告的 pass@1 表现。
基于 138k 条 SSA 生成的 agent trajectories，论文将分析从单一 pass@1 扩展到代码状态空间中的行为轨迹。
通过编辑频率、测试活动、阶段转换等细粒度指标，揭示不同模型在自主问题求解流程中的策略差异。

llm_assessment.comment: This paper is strongly aligned with harness observability, using large-scale trajectories to expose model-harness gaps and guide reusable agent runtime design.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 该论文高度契合智能体运行框架可观测性，通过大规模轨迹揭示模型与框架之间的执行鸿沟。
